# B312 Architecture Decisions

1. No new policy store.
2. Handoff lives immediately before final ActionOwnership boundary.
3. Promotion is safety-gated and cannot override explicit user request.
4. Verified evidence can confirm an existing choice or promote a different choice.
5. Neighbor-context transfer remains bounded and requires verified evidence.
6. Natural whole-organism shift is measured separately from causal promotion capability.
7. B312 state is persisted and migrated under schema 127 without a schema bump.
